title: Topic 9
japanese_text: <u>しゅうと</u>は<u>晩年</u>、残された時間を<u>しゅうとめ</u>と2人で楽しんでいたそうだ。しゅうとの<u>誠実な</u><u>人柄</u>から、2人の時間を大切にしたかったのではないかと想像し、温かい気持ちになった。
english_translation: I hear that in his later years, my father-in-law enjoyed the time he had left together with my mother-in-law. Knowing his sincere personality, I imagine he wanted to cherish their time together, which gives me a warm feeling.
